title: Relative Time Card
lede: Popover to show a given date in local time.

examples.heading: Default
Open
examples.description: The card open on each side of a button trigger (a client-only state drawn from the component's class strings): the context card's overlay, fader, shell and stem around the card's own content, a column at least 300px wide with the full age in tabular figures over two zone rows, each a zone chip in monospace beside the date and the clock time at the row's end.

examples.heading: Plain
examples.description: The card with no trigger of its own: the short age (days, hours or minutes ago, or Just now) as a 14px label in gray-900, inside the context card's trigger wrapper.
